outages.serving: Street (NE corner of Bushwick Avenue and Grand Street) to 8 Ave-bound platform
Street (NE corner of Bushwick Avenue and Grand Street) to 8 Ave-bound platform
Transfer mezzanine to Manhattan-bound 4 platform and Manhattan-bound 2/5 platform.

equipment.serving: Transfer mezzanine to Manhattan-bound 4 platform and Manhattan-bound 2/5 platform.
equipment.shortdescription: Mezzanine to Manhattan-bound 4 platform and Manhattan-bound 2/5 platform.
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you are on the transfer mezzanine:  

For Manhattan-bound 4/5, take a Woodlawn-bound 4 to 161 St – Yankee Stadium and transfer to a Manhattan-bound 4. Transfer at 125 St for 5.  

For Manhattan-bound 2, take an Eastchester-Dyre Av-bound 5 or a Wakefield-241 St-bound 2 to 3 Av – 149 St. See agent to transfer to a Manhattan-bound 2.  

If you are on the Manhattan-bound 4 platform: Take a Manhattan-bound 4 to 125 St and transfer to a Bronx-bound 4 or 5 to 149 St – Grand Concourse. For 2, take a Bronx-bound 5 and transfer at 149 St – Grand Concourse.  

If you are on the Manhattan-bound 2/5 platform: Take a Manhattan-bound 5 to 125 St and transfer to a Bronx-bound 4 or 5 to 149 St – Grand Concourse.

equipment.serving: Transfer mezzanine to Woodlawn-bound 4 platform and Bronx-bound 2/5 platform.
equipment.shortdescription: Mezzanine to Woodlawn-bound 4 platform and Bronx-bound 2/5 platform.
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you are in the transfer mezzanine:  

For Woodlawn-bound 4 and Eastchester-Dyre Av-bound 5, take a Manhattan-bound 4 or 5 to 125 St and transfer to a Bronx-bound 4 or 5.  

For Wakefield-241 St-bound 2, take a Manhattan-bound 4 or 5 to 125 St and take a Bronx-bound 5. Transfer to 2 at 149 St – Grand Concourse. 

If you are on the Woodlawn-bound 4 platform:  

To exit, take a Woodlawn-bound 4 to 161 St – Yankee Stadium and transfer to a Manhattan-bound 4 to 149 St – Grand Concourse.  

For 2/5, take a Woodlawn-bound 4 to 161 St – Yankee Stadium. Then, transfer to a Manhattan-bound 4 to 125 St. Then, transfer to a Bronx-bound 5.  

If you are on the Eastchester-Dyre Av/Wakefield-241 St-bound 2/5 platform:  

To exit, take an Eastchester-Dyre Av-bound 5 or a Wakefield-241 St-bound 2 to 3 Av – 149 St. Transfer to a Riverbank Park-bound Bx19 bus to E 149 St / Grand Concourse.  

For 4, take a Wakefield-241 St-bound 2 or an Eastchester-Dyre Av-bound 5 to 3 Av – 149 St. See agent to transfer to a Manhattan-bound 5 and take it to 125 St. Then, transfer to a Bronx-bound 4.

equipment.serving: 149 St & Grand Concourse (SW corner) to mezzanine for 2, 4, and 5 service in all directions.
equipment.shortdescription: 149 St & Grand Concourse (SW corner) to mezzanine for 2, 4, and 5 service.
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you are on the street: For 2/5, take a Bronx Park-bound Bx19 bus to 3 Av - 149 St 2/5 station. For 4, take a Riverdale-bound Bx1 LTD bus or Kingsbridge Hts-bound Bx2 bus to Grand Concourse / E 161 St. Proceed west along E 161 St to River Av for the 161 St – Yankee Stadium station.  

If you are in the transfer mezzanine: Take a Wakefield-241 St-bound 2 or an Eastchester-Dyre Av-bound 5 to 3 Av – 149 St. Transfer to a Riverbank Park-bound Bx19 bus to E 149 St / Grand Concourse.

equipment.serving: Street (NE corner of Bushwick Avenue and Grand Street) to 8 Ave-bound platform
equipment.alternativeroute:
If you’re on the street:  
Cross the Bushwick Ave and use EL786 to take a Canarsie-bound L train to Myrtle-Wyckoff station. Then, transfer across the platform for a Manhattan-bound L train.  
Or, 
Take a Williamsburg-bound Q59 bus (Grand St & Bushwick Av) to N 5 St. Then, proceed two blocks north and 2 blocks west to Bedford Av L station for service in both directions. 

If you’re on the platform: 
Take a Manhattan-bound L train to Bedford Av station. Then, transfer across the platform to a Canarsie-bound L train to Grand St.
